properties.name: peach.scheduler.executor.application-name
properties.description: Logical application name used by scheduler metadata.

properties.name: peach.scheduler.executor.instance-id
properties.description: Executor instance id reported with scheduler lease claims. Empty values use the local host name when available.

properties.name: peach.scheduler.executor.default-timeout-ms
properties.description: Best-effort execution timeout in milliseconds. Values less than or equal to zero wait indefinitely.

properties.name: peach.scheduler.executor.max-error-message-length
properties.description: Maximum sanitized error message length reported back to the scheduler control plane.
